import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Fujita conjecture

Let $M$ be a compact complex manifold of complex dimension $n$, let $L$ be a positive
(equivalently, by the Kodaira embedding theorem, ample) holomorphic line bundle on $M$ and let
$K_M$ be the canonical line bundle of $M$. Fujita's conjecture states that the line bundle
$K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is
* spanned by (global holomorphic) sections when $m \geq n + 1$;
* very ample when $m \geq n + 2$.

The notions involved are formulated for holomorphic line bundles over a complex manifold `M`
modelled on a complex normed space via `I : ModelWithCorners ℂ EM HM` (in the conjecture itself,
`I = 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n))`):
* a holomorphic line bundle is a vector bundle `E : M → Type*` with model fibre `ℂ` whose
  changes of trivialisation are complex analytic (`ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ E I`), and its
  holomorphic sections are the complex analytic sections `Cₛ^ω⟮I; ℂ, E⟯`;
* a line bundle is *spanned by sections* if its global holomorphic sections span every fibre;
* a line bundle is *very ample* if its global holomorphic sections span every fibre, separate
  points and separate tangent vectors; for compact `M` this says exactly that the global
  holomorphic sections define a holomorphic embedding of `M` into a projective space;
* a line bundle is *ample* if some positive tensor power is very ample; on a compact complex
  manifold this is equivalent to positivity by the Kodaira embedding theorem;
* since Mathlib has no tensor products or exterior powers of vector bundles, the bundle
  $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is characterised up to isomorphism: `IsAdjointBundle I L m E` says
  that `E` carries a holomorphic fibrewise multiplication
  $\Lambda^n T_x^*M \times L_x^m \to E_x$ which is nonzero on nonzero pure tensors, i.e. that
  `E` is isomorphic to $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$. The conjecture is stated for every such `E`.

*References:*
* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fujita_conjecture)
* [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
* T. Fujita, *On polarized manifolds whose adjoint bundles are not semipositive*,
  Algebraic geometry, Sendai, 1985, Adv. Stud. Pure Math. 10 (1987), 167–178.
  [doi:10.2969/aspm/01010167](https://doi.org/10.2969/aspm/01010167)
* L. Ein, R. Lazarsfeld, *Global generation of pluricanonical and adjoint linear series on smooth
  projective threefolds*, J. Amer. Math. Soc. 6 (1993), 875–903.
  [doi:10.1090/S0894-0347-1993-1207013-5](https://doi.org/10.1090/S0894-0347-1993-1207013-5)
-/

namespace FujitaConjecture

open Bundle Function
open scoped Manifold ContDiff

universe u v

variable {EM HM : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup EM] [NormedSpace ℂ EM] [TopologicalSpace HM]
  (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ EM HM) {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace HM M]

/-- A local section `s` of a vector bundle `V` (with model fibre `F`) over the complex manifold
`M` is *holomorphic on* the set `U` if it is complex analytic on `U`. -/
def IsHolomorphicSectionOn (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (V : M → Type*) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace F V)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (V x)]
    [FiberBundle F V] (s : ∀ x, V x) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ContMDiffOn I (I.prod 𝓘(ℂ, F)) ω (fun x ↦ TotalSpace.mk' F x (s x)) U

/-- The holomorphic cotangent bundle of the complex manifold `M`: the fibre at `x` is the dual of
the holomorphic tangent space at `x`. -/
abbrev CotangentSpace (x : M) : Type _ := TangentSpace I x →L[ℂ] Trivial M ℂ x

section LineBundle

variable (E : M → Type u) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ E)] [∀ x, AddCommGroup (E x)]
  [∀ x, Module ℂ (E x)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (E x)] [FiberBundle ℂ E]

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `E` is *spanned by sections* (globally generated, base point free)
if for every point `x` the evaluation map from the space of global holomorphic sections of `E`
to the fibre `E x` is surjective. -/
def IsGloballyGenerated : Prop :=
  ∀ x, Surjective fun s : Cₛ^ω⟮I; ℂ, E⟯ ↦ s x

/-- The global holomorphic sections of `E` *separate points* if for any two distinct points
`x ≠ y` the evaluation map to `E x × E y` is surjective. -/
def SeparatesPoints : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, x ≠ y → Surjective fun s : Cₛ^ω⟮I; ℂ, E⟯ ↦ (s x, s y)

/-- The derivative at `x` of the holomorphic section `s` of `E`, computed in the trivialisation
`trivializationAt ℂ E x` of `E` around `x`. When `s x = 0` this element of the cotangent space
$T_x^*M$ does not depend on the choice of holomorphic trivialisation: it is the image of `s` in
$\mathfrak{m}_x E_x / \mathfrak{m}_x^2 E_x \cong T_x^*M \otimes E_x \cong T_x^*M$. -/
noncomputable def localDerivAt (x : M) (s : Cₛ^ω⟮I; ℂ, E⟯) : CotangentSpace I x :=
  mfderiv I 𝓘(ℂ) (fun y ↦ (trivializationAt ℂ E x (TotalSpace.mk' ℂ y (s y))).2) x

/-- The global holomorphic sections of `E` *separate tangent vectors* if for every point `x`
the derivatives at `x` of the global holomorphic sections vanishing at `x` span the whole
cotangent space $T_x^*M$. -/
def SeparatesTangentVectors : Prop :=
  ∀ x, Surjective fun s : {s : Cₛ^ω⟮I; ℂ, E⟯ // s x = 0} ↦ localDerivAt I E x s.1

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `E` on `M` is *very ample* if its global holomorphic sections span
every fibre, separate points and separate tangent vectors. For a compact complex manifold `M`
this is equivalent to the classical definition: the global holomorphic sections of `E` define a
holomorphic embedding of `M` into a projective space $\mathbb{P}^N$ under which `E` is the
pullback of $\mathcal{O}(1)$. -/
def IsVeryAmple : Prop :=
  IsGloballyGenerated I E ∧ SeparatesPoints I E ∧ SeparatesTangentVectors I E

omit [∀ x, Module ℂ (E x)] in
/-- A very ample line bundle is spanned by sections. -/
@[category API, AMS 14 32]
theorem IsVeryAmple.isGloballyGenerated (h : IsVeryAmple I E) : IsGloballyGenerated I E :=
  h.1

end LineBundle

section TensorPowers

variable (L : M → Type v) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ L)] [∀ x, AddCommGroup (L x)]
  [∀ x, Module ℂ (L x)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (L x)] [FiberBundle ℂ L]

/-- `IsTensorPower I L k P` says that the holomorphic line bundle `P` is (isomorphic to) the
`k`-th tensor power $L^{\otimes k}$ of the holomorphic line bundle `L`. This is witnessed by a
fibrewise `k`-multilinear multiplication map $\mu_x \colon L_x^k \to P_x$ which is nonzero on
nonzero pure tensors (so that it induces an isomorphism $L_x^{\otimes k} \cong P_x$ of
one-dimensional spaces) and which is holomorphic, in the sense that it maps holomorphic local
sections of `L` to a holomorphic local section of `P`. -/
def IsTensorPower (k : ℕ) (P : M → Type*) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ P)]
    [∀ x, AddCommGroup (P x)] [∀ x, Module ℂ (P x)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (P x)]
    [FiberBundle ℂ P] : Prop :=
  ∃ μ : ∀ x, MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin k ↦ L x) (P x),
    (∀ x (l : Fin k → L x), (∀ i, l i ≠ 0) → μ x l ≠ 0) ∧
    ∀ (U : Set M), IsOpen U → ∀ s : Fin k → ∀ x, L x,
      (∀ i, IsHolomorphicSectionOn I ℂ L (s i) U) →
      IsHolomorphicSectionOn I ℂ P (fun x ↦ μ x fun i ↦ s i x) U

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `L` on `M` is *ample* if some positive tensor power
$L^{\otimes k}$ is very ample. On a compact complex manifold this is equivalent, by the Kodaira
embedding theorem, to `L` being *positive*, i.e. admitting a hermitian metric whose Chern
curvature form is positive definite. -/
def IsAmple : Prop :=
  ∃ k, 0 < k ∧ ∃ (P : M → Type v) (_ : TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ P))
    (_ : ∀ x, AddCommGroup (P x)) (_ : ∀ x, Module ℂ (P x)) (_ : ∀ x, TopologicalSpace (P x))
    (_ : FiberBundle ℂ P) (_ : VectorBundle ℂ ℂ P) (_ : ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ P I),
    IsTensorPower I L k P ∧ IsVeryAmple I P

/-- A very ample line bundle is ample (take `k = 1` and `P = L`). -/
@[category API, AMS 14 32]
theorem IsVeryAmple.isAmple [VectorBundle ℂ ℂ L] [ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ L I]
    (h : IsVeryAmple I L) : IsAmple I L := by
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, L, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, inferInstance,
    ⟨fun x ↦ MultilinearMap.ofSubsingleton ℂ (L x) (L x) 0 LinearMap.id, ?_, ?_⟩, h⟩
  · intro x l hl
    simpa using hl 0
  · intro U _ s hs
    simpa using hs 0

variable [IsManifold I ω M]

/-- `IsAdjointBundle I L m E` says that the holomorphic line bundle `E` is (isomorphic to) the
adjoint bundle $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$, where $K_M = \Lambda^n T^*M$ is the canonical line
bundle of the complex manifold `M` of dimension `n = Module.finrank ℂ EM`. This is witnessed by
a fibrewise multiplication map $\Phi_x \colon (T_x^*M)^n \times L_x^m \to E_x$ which is
alternating in the `n` cotangent vectors and multilinear in the `m` elements of `L_x`, which is
nonzero on nonzero pure tensors (i.e. whenever the cotangent vectors are linearly independent and
the elements of `L_x` are nonzero, so that it induces an isomorphism
$\Lambda^n T_x^*M \otimes L_x^{\otimes m} \cong E_x$ of one-dimensional spaces), and which is
holomorphic, in the sense that it maps holomorphic local `1`-forms and holomorphic local sections
of `L` to a holomorphic local section of `E`. -/
def IsAdjointBundle (m : ℕ) (E : M → Type u) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ E)]
    [∀ x, AddCommGroup (E x)] [∀ x, Module ℂ (E x)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (E x)]
    [FiberBundle ℂ E] : Prop :=
  ∃ Φ : ∀ x, CotangentSpace I x [⋀^Fin (Module.finrank ℂ EM)]→ₗ[ℂ]
      MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin m ↦ L x) (E x),
    (∀ x (ξ : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ EM) → CotangentSpace I x) (l : Fin m → L x),
      LinearIndependent ℂ ξ → (∀ i, l i ≠ 0) → Φ x ξ l ≠ 0) ∧
    ∀ (U : Set M), IsOpen U →
      ∀ (ξ : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ EM) → ∀ x, CotangentSpace I x) (s : Fin m → ∀ x, L x),
      (∀ i, IsHolomorphicSectionOn I (EM →L[ℂ] ℂ) (CotangentSpace I) (ξ i) U) →
      (∀ i, IsHolomorphicSectionOn I ℂ L (s i) U) →
      IsHolomorphicSectionOn I ℂ E (fun x ↦ Φ x (fun i ↦ ξ i x) fun i ↦ s i x) U

end TensorPowers

variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) M]
  [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) ω M] [CompactSpace M] [T2Space M]
  (L : M → Type v) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ L)] [∀ x, AddCommGroup (L x)]
  [∀ x, Module ℂ (L x)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (L x)] [FiberBundle ℂ L] [VectorBundle ℂ ℂ L]
  [ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ L 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n))]
  (E : M → Type u) [TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ E)] [∀ x, AddCommGroup (E x)]
  [∀ x, Module ℂ (E x)] [∀ x, TopologicalSpace (E x)] [FiberBundle ℂ E] [VectorBundle ℂ ℂ E]
  [ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ E 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n))]

/-- **Fujita conjecture, part (i)** (freeness): let `M` be a compact complex manifold of complex
dimension `n`, let `L` be a positive (equivalently, ample) holomorphic line bundle on `M` and let
$K_M$ be the canonical line bundle of `M`. Then for every `m ≥ n + 1` the line bundle
$K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is spanned by its global holomorphic sections.

Here `E` is any holomorphic line bundle isomorphic to $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$, see
`IsAdjointBundle`. -/
@[category research open, AMS 14 32]
theorem fujita_conjecture.parts.i (hL : IsAmple 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) L)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 ≤ m) (hE : IsAdjointBundle 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) L m E) :
    IsGloballyGenerated 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) E := by
  sorry

/-- **Fujita conjecture, part (ii)** (very ampleness): let `M` be a compact complex manifold of
complex dimension `n`, let `L` be a positive (equivalently, ample) holomorphic line bundle on `M`
and let $K_M$ be the canonical line bundle of `M`. Then for every `m ≥ n + 2` the line bundle
$K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is very ample.

Here `E` is any holomorphic line bundle isomorphic to $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$, see
`IsAdjointBundle`. -/
@[category research open, AMS 14 32]
theorem fujita_conjecture.parts.ii (hL : IsAmple 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) L)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 2 ≤ m) (hE : IsAdjointBundle 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) L m E) :
    IsVeryAmple 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) E := by
  sorry

end FujitaConjecture
attempts.decomposition_objections: None. The two-part decomposition (freeness for m ≥ n+1, very ampleness for m ≥ n+2) matches the article and Fujita's original formulation; both parts are formalized under the same hypotheses as the notes indicate.
modeling_decisions: 'Compact complex manifold of complex dimension n' is modelled as [ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) ω M] [CompactSpace M] [T2Space M] (ω = complex analytic = holomorphic transition maps). Connectedness/nonemptiness are not required; the statement for a disjoint union is equivalent to the statement on each component, and empty/0-dimensional cases are trivially true.

'Holomorphic line bundle' = vector bundle with model fibre ℂ over ℂ whose changes of trivialisation are C^ω (ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ E I); holomorphic (global) sections = ContMDiffSection Cₛ^ω⟮I; ℂ, E⟯; holomorphic local sections on an open U = ContMDiffOn ... ω on U (IsHolomorphicSectionOn).

'Positive' is modelled as 'ample', following the decomposition notes (positive ⇔ ample on compact complex manifolds by the Kodaira embedding theorem). Ample is defined as: some tensor power L^{⊗k}, k > 0, is very ample (IsAmple). The tensor power is represented by an existentially quantified holomorphic line bundle P (fibres in the same universe as L) together with a witness IsTensorPower I L k P.
'Spanned by sections' = for every x the evaluation map from global holomorphic sections to E x is surjective (IsGloballyGenerated).

'Very ample' is defined via the standard equivalent characterisation for compact complex manifolds: global holomorphic sections span every fibre, separate points (evaluation to E x × E y surjective for x ≠ y) and separate tangent vectors (for each x, the derivatives at x — computed in trivializationAt ℂ E x, which is intrinsic when the section vanishes at x — of the global sections vanishing at x fill out T_x^*M). This replaces 'the sections give a closed embedding into projective space', which cannot be expressed since Mathlib has no complex-manifold structure on projective space. The equivalence (injective immersion of a compact manifold is an embedding; conversely hyperplane sections separate points and tangent vectors) is classical (Hartshorne II.7.3, Griffiths–Harris/Huybrechts Kodaira embedding).

K_M ⊗ L^{⊗m} is not constructed (Mathlib has no tensor products or exterior powers of vector bundles). Instead the conjecture is quantified over every holomorphic line bundle E satisfying IsAdjointBundle I L m E: existence of a fibrewise map Φ_x, alternating in n = finrank ℂ EM cotangent vectors (elements of CotangentSpace I x := TangentSpace I x →L[ℂ] Trivial M ℂ x, the Hom bundle) and multilinear in m elements of L_x, with values in E_x, nonzero whenever the cotangent vectors are linearly independent and the L-elements are nonzero (so Λ^n T_x^*M ⊗ L_x^{⊗m} ≅ E_x), and holomorphic in the sense that it sends holomorphic local 1-forms and holomorphic local sections of L on any open U to a holomorphic local section of E on U. Such E are exactly the bundles holomorphically isomorphic to K_M ⊗ L^{⊗m}, and both conclusions are isomorphism invariant, so the universally quantified statement is equivalent to the original. In the theorem, n = Module.finrank ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) appears inside IsAdjointBundle (provably equal to n).
The canonical bundle is the holomorphic canonical bundle Λ^n T^*M where TangentSpace I is Mathlib's tangent space of the ℂ-analytic manifold (the holomorphic tangent bundle T^{1,0}M).

Definitions take the model with corners I explicitly (Mathlib idiom, as in Cₛ^ω⟮I; F, V⟯) because n cannot be inferred from instance arguments alone; the two slots instantiate I := 𝓘(ℂ, EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)).

All bespoke definitions are kept in the problem file (the task allows writing a single file); a reviewer may wish to move the generic ones (IsHolomorphicSectionOn, CotangentSpace, IsGloballyGenerated, SeparatesPoints, SeparatesTangentVectors, IsVeryAmple, IsTensorPower, IsAmple) to FormalConjecturesForMathlib. Two small API lemmas (IsVeryAmple.isGloballyGenerated, IsVeryAmple.isAmple with k = 1, P = L) are proved as sanity checks; the second confirms the holomorphy condition of IsTensorPower is satisfiable.

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Fujita conjecture

Let $M$ be a compact complex manifold of complex dimension $n$, let $L$ be a positive
holomorphic line bundle on $M$ and let $K_M$ be the canonical line bundle of $M$.
Fujita's conjecture (1985) states that the line bundle $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is
1. spanned by sections when $m \geq n + 1$;
2. very ample when $m \geq n + 2$.

By the Kodaira embedding theorem, a holomorphic line bundle on a compact complex manifold is
positive (i.e. admits a hermitian metric with positive curvature) if and only if it is ample,
i.e. some positive tensor power of it is very ample. We use this second formulation.

Mathlib has complex manifolds and holomorphic (`C^ω` over `ℂ`) vector bundles, but not yet
tensor products of line bundles, the canonical bundle, or (very) ampleness. We therefore
characterise these notions up to isomorphism in this file:
* `K_M` is characterised by its local frames $dz_1 \wedge \dots \wedge dz_n$ attached to the
  charts, which transform by the Jacobian determinants of the chart transitions;
* $L_1 \otimes L_2$ is characterised by a holomorphic fibrewise bilinear map
  $L_1 \times L_2 \to N$ which is nonzero on pairs of nonzero vectors;
* very ampleness is characterised by the global holomorphic sections separating points and
  tangent vectors (and having no base points).

*References:*
* [Wikipedia, Fujita conjecture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fujita_conjecture)
* [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
* [Fuj1987] T. Fujita, *On polarized manifolds whose adjoint bundles are not semipositive*,
  Algebraic geometry, Sendai, 1985, Adv. Stud. Pure Math. 10 (1987), 167–178.
  [doi:10.2969/aspm/01010167](https://doi.org/10.2969/aspm/01010167)
-/

namespace FujitaConjecture

open scoped Manifold ContDiff Bundle
open Bundle

universe u

variable (n : ℕ) (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (Fin n → ℂ) M]

/-- A holomorphic line bundle on a complex manifold `M` of complex dimension `n`
(modelled on `Fin n → ℂ`): a complex vector bundle with fibre `ℂ` whose transition
functions are holomorphic, i.e. `C^ω` over `ℂ`. -/
structure HolomorphicLineBundle where
  /-- The fibres of the line bundle. -/
  E : M → Type u
  [topFiber : ∀ x, TopologicalSpace (E x)]
  [addCommGroup : ∀ x, AddCommGroup (E x)]
  [module : ∀ x, Module ℂ (E x)]
  [topTotalSpace : TopologicalSpace (TotalSpace ℂ E)]
  [fiberBundle : FiberBundle ℂ E]
  [vectorBundle : VectorBundle ℂ ℂ E]
  [holomorphic : ContMDiffVectorBundle ω ℂ E 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ)]

attribute [instance] HolomorphicLineBundle.topFiber HolomorphicLineBundle.addCommGroup
  HolomorphicLineBundle.module HolomorphicLineBundle.topTotalSpace
  HolomorphicLineBundle.fiberBundle HolomorphicLineBundle.vectorBundle
  HolomorphicLineBundle.holomorphic

variable {n M}

namespace HolomorphicLineBundle

/-- The global holomorphic sections of a holomorphic line bundle `L`. -/
abbrev GlobalSections (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) : Type _ :=
  Cₛ^ω⟮𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ); ℂ, L.E⟯

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `L` is *spanned by sections* (globally generated, base-point
free) if for every point `x` of `M` some global holomorphic section of `L` does not vanish
at `x`. -/
def IsGloballyGenerated (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : M, ∃ s : L.GlobalSections, s x ≠ 0

/-- The differential at `x` of a holomorphic section `s` of `L`, computed in the local
trivialisation `trivializationAt ℂ L.E x`, i.e. the differential at `x` of the coefficient
function of `s` with respect to a local holomorphic frame near `x`. When `s x = 0` this linear
form on `T_x M` does not depend on the choice of the local trivialisation. -/
noncomputable def sectionDeriv (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (s : L.GlobalSections)
    (x : M) : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) x →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  mfderiv 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ)
    (fun y => (trivializationAt ℂ L.E x (TotalSpace.mk' ℂ y (s y))).2) x

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `L` on a compact complex manifold `M` is *very ample* if its
global holomorphic sections define a holomorphic (closed) embedding of `M` into a projective
space. Equivalently (see e.g. Hartshorne, *Algebraic Geometry*, Prop. II.7.3):
* `L` is spanned by sections;
* the sections separate points: for `x ≠ y` there is a section vanishing at `x` but not at `y`;
* the sections separate tangent vectors: for every nonzero `v ∈ T_x M` there is a section
  `s` vanishing at `x` whose differential at `x` does not kill `v`. -/
def IsVeryAmple (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) : Prop :=
  L.IsGloballyGenerated ∧
    (∀ x y : M, x ≠ y → ∃ s : L.GlobalSections, s x = 0 ∧ s y ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) x), v ≠ 0 →
      ∃ s : L.GlobalSections, s x = 0 ∧ L.sectionDeriv s x v ≠ 0)

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `K` on `M` is (isomorphic to) the *canonical bundle*
$K_M = \Lambda^n T^*M$ of `M` if it admits, for every chart `φ` of `M`, a nowhere vanishing
holomorphic section `σ φ` over the domain of `φ` (playing the role of the local frame
$dz_1 \wedge \dots \wedge dz_n$ in the coordinates `z = φ`), such that for two charts `φ` and
`ψ` these local frames are related on the overlap by the Jacobian determinant of the
transition map: `σ ψ = det (D(ψ ∘ φ⁻¹)) • σ φ`. -/
def IsCanonical (K : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M (Fin n → ℂ) → ∀ y : M, K.E y,
    (∀ φ ∈ atlas (Fin n → ℂ) M, ∀ y ∈ φ.source, σ φ y ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ φ ∈ atlas (Fin n → ℂ) M,
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) (𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ)) ω
        (fun y => TotalSpace.mk' ℂ y (σ φ y)) φ.source) ∧
    (∀ φ ∈ atlas (Fin n → ℂ) M, ∀ ψ ∈ atlas (Fin n → ℂ) M, ∀ y ∈ φ.source ∩ ψ.source,
      σ ψ y = (fderiv ℂ (fun z => ψ (φ.symm z)) (φ y)).det • σ φ y)

/-- `IsTensorProduct L₁ L₂ N` says that the holomorphic line bundle `N` is (isomorphic to) the
tensor product `L₁ ⊗ L₂`: there is a holomorphic map of total spaces `L₁ ×ᵇ L₂ → N` over `M`
which is bilinear on each fibre and nonzero on pairs of nonzero vectors (so that it induces
fibrewise isomorphisms `L₁ x ⊗ L₂ x ≃ N x`). -/
def IsTensorProduct (L₁ L₂ N : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) : Prop :=
  ∃ Φ : ∀ x, L₁.E x →ₗ[ℂ] L₂.E x →ₗ[ℂ] N.E x,
    (∀ x (a : L₁.E x) (b : L₂.E x), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → Φ x a b ≠ 0) ∧
    ContMDiff (𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ × ℂ)) (𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ, ℂ)) ω
      (fun p : TotalSpace (ℂ × ℂ) (L₁.E ×ᵇ L₂.E) =>
        TotalSpace.mk' ℂ p.proj (Φ p.proj p.snd.1 p.snd.2))

/-- `IsTensorPower L m N` says that the holomorphic line bundle `N` is (isomorphic to) the
`m`-th tensor power `L^{⊗ m}` of `L`, for `m ≥ 1`: `L^{⊗ 1}` is `L` itself, and `L^{⊗ (k + 1)}`
is any tensor product of `L^{⊗ k}` with `L` in the sense of `IsTensorProduct`. -/
inductive IsTensorPower (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) :
    ℕ → HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M → Prop
  | one : IsTensorPower L 1 L
  | succ {k : ℕ} {N N' : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M} :
      IsTensorPower L k N → IsTensorProduct N L N' → IsTensorPower L (k + 1) N'

/-- A holomorphic line bundle `L` on a compact complex manifold is *ample* if some positive
tensor power `L^{⊗ k}` of `L` is very ample. By the Kodaira embedding theorem this is
equivalent to `L` being *positive*, i.e. carrying a hermitian metric with positive curvature. -/
def IsAmple (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ ∃ N : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M, IsTensorPower L k N ∧ N.IsVeryAmple

@[category API, AMS 14 32]
theorem IsVeryAmple.isGloballyGenerated {L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M}
    (h : L.IsVeryAmple) : L.IsGloballyGenerated :=
  h.1

@[category API, AMS 14 32]
theorem IsVeryAmple.isAmple {L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M} (h : L.IsVeryAmple) :
    L.IsAmple :=
  ⟨1, one_pos, L, .one, h⟩

@[category API, AMS 14 32]
theorem IsTensorPower.eq_of_one {L N : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M}
    (h : IsTensorPower L 1 N) : N = L := by
  cases h with
  | one => rfl
  | succ h _ => cases h

@[category API, AMS 14 32]
theorem isTensorPower_two_iff {L N : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M} :
    IsTensorPower L 2 N ↔ HolomorphicLineBundle.IsTensorProduct L L N := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | succ h h' => rwa [h.eq_of_one] at h'
  · intro h
    exact .succ .one h

end HolomorphicLineBundle

/-- **Fujita conjecture, part (i) (freeness).**
Let $M$ be a compact complex manifold of complex dimension $n$, let $L$ be a positive
(equivalently, by the Kodaira embedding theorem, ample) holomorphic line bundle on $M$ and let
$K_M$ be the canonical line bundle of $M$. Then $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is spanned by
sections for every $m \geq n + 1$. -/
@[category research open, AMS 14 32]

    [CompactSpace M] [ChartedSpace (Fin n → ℂ) M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) ω M]
    (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hL : L.IsAmple) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 ≤ m)
    (K : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hK : K.IsCanonical)
    (Lm : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hLm : HolomorphicLineBundle.IsTensorPower L m Lm)
    (A : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hA : HolomorphicLineBundle.IsTensorProduct K Lm A) :
    A.IsGloballyGenerated := by
  sorry

/-- **Fujita conjecture, part (ii) (very ampleness).**
Let $M$ be a compact complex manifold of complex dimension $n$, let $L$ be a positive
(equivalently, by the Kodaira embedding theorem, ample) holomorphic line bundle on $M$ and let
$K_M$ be the canonical line bundle of $M$. Then $K_M \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ is very ample
for every $m \geq n + 2$. -/
@[category research open, AMS 14 32]
theorem fujita_conjecture.parts.ii {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M]
    [CompactSpace M] [ChartedSpace (Fin n → ℂ) M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) ω M]
    (L : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hL : L.IsAmple) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 2 ≤ m)
    (K : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hK : K.IsCanonical)
    (Lm : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hLm : HolomorphicLineBundle.IsTensorPower L m Lm)
    (A : HolomorphicLineBundle.{u} n M) (hA : HolomorphicLineBundle.IsTensorProduct K Lm A) :

end FujitaConjecture

K_M ⊗ L^{⊗m} is not constructed; instead the theorems universally quantify over all bundles K, Lm, A satisfying `IsCanonical K`, `IsTensorPower L m Lm`, `IsTensorProduct K Lm A`. Each predicate characterises the intended bundle exactly up to holomorphic isomorphism, and both conclusions (global generation, very ampleness) are isomorphism invariant. A reviewer should check satisfiability (canonical bundle and tensor products exist, so the hypotheses are not vacuous) and the characterisations: (a) `IsTensorProduct L₁ L₂ N`: a holomorphic fibrewise bilinear map L₁ ×ᵇ L₂ → N nonzero on pairs of nonzero vectors (for 1-dimensional fibres this is exactly an iso L₁⊗L₂ ≅ N, holomorphic since in local frames it is a nonvanishing holomorphic function); (b) `IsTensorPower`: inductive, L^{⊗1} = L, L^{⊗(k+1)} = L^{⊗k} ⊗ L; (c) `IsCanonical K`: for every chart φ of the atlas a nowhere-vanishing holomorphic local section σ φ on φ.source, with σ ψ = det(D(ψ ∘ φ⁻¹)(φ y)) • σ φ on overlaps, i.e. the transformation law of dz₁∧…∧dzₙ (the direction of the determinant was checked: the inverse would characterise the anticanonical bundle).

Very ampleness is defined by the classical criterion (base-point free + separates points + separates tangent vectors) rather than via an embedding into ℙ^N, since Mathlib has no complex projective space as a complex manifold nor O(1). The tangent-vector condition uses `sectionDeriv`, the mfderiv at x of the coefficient of s in `trivializationAt ℂ L.E x`; for a section with s x = 0 this is independent of the trivialisation.
'Spanned by sections' is modelled as: for every x there is a global holomorphic section nonzero at x (for a line bundle this is exactly global generation / base-point freeness).

Four easy `@[category API]` lemmas with proofs are included as sanity checks of the bespoke definitions (very ample ⟹ globally generated, very ample ⟹ ample, L^{⊗1} = L, L^{⊗2} ↔ IsTensorProduct L L). Per repository rules the reusable definitions would ideally live in FormalConjecturesForMathlib, but the task restricted output to the single problem file.

fujita_conjecture.parts.i.why: Stated as `fujita_conjecture.parts.i`: for every compact Hausdorff complex manifold M modelled on Fin n → ℂ (IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ, Fin n → ℂ) ω M, CompactSpace, T2Space), every ample holomorphic line bundle L, every m with n + 1 ≤ m, every K characterised as the canonical bundle, every Lm characterised as L^{⊗m} and every A characterised as K ⊗ Lm, A is globally generated (every point has a global holomorphic section not vanishing there). Mathlib has complex manifolds, C^ω vector bundles, sections, product bundles, mfderiv/fderiv and determinants, but no tensor products of bundles, canonical bundle, or (very) ampleness, so these are characterised up to isomorphism by bespoke definitions in the file.

fujita_conjecture.parts.ii.why: Stated as `fujita_conjecture.parts.ii` with the same hypotheses but n + 2 ≤ m and conclusion `A.IsVeryAmple`, where very ampleness is the standard characterisation (Hartshorne II.7.3 / Griffiths–Harris): globally generated, global holomorphic sections separate points, and sections vanishing at x separate tangent vectors at x (differential at the zero x, computed in `trivializationAt`, is nonzero on the given tangent vector). On a compact manifold this is exactly 'the complete linear system of L gives a closed holomorphic embedding into projective space'.
